note: Data classes of the Router's tables (addendum 2026-10-29, C.2). reference = shipped with Walter Clean (rows matching instance_rows excluded); instance = the person's data (empty in Clean, restored by Walter Personal); runtime = recomputed by the Router (empty in Clean). Walter Clean keeps the engine, catalogue, rankings, prices, task definitions and strategies; it drops usage, budgets, preferences, accounts and everything written for the owner.

models.benchmarks.instance_rows: snapshot_id in (select snapshot_id from models.snapshots where kind in ('declared', 'codex', 'claude_pro', 'hermes_providers'))

models.offers.instance_rows: snapshot_id in (select snapshot_id from models.snapshots where kind in ('declared', 'codex', 'claude_pro', 'hermes_providers')) or access = 'subscription'

models.endpoints.instance_rows: snapshot_id in (select snapshot_id from models.snapshots where kind in ('declared', 'codex', 'claude_pro', 'hermes_providers'))

models.dossiers.note: written for the owner by the analysis model; a new instance rebuilds them on its first cycle

models.selection.note: computed from catalogue, preferences and subscriptions

models.schema_migrations.note: written by the Router's migration runner
